findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Inspector observed boxes of food items stored directly on the floor of the walk-in freezer connected to the main kitchen space. The PIC was informed and pallets/crates will be acquired to lift food items off the ground. Ensure storage is corrected prior to next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.citation_text:
3-501.16(A)(2) Inspector observed the following foods to be out of temperature. All items were probed: One Applewood Carving Ham (52F), Two Tubes of Salami (52F), One Capocollo Ham (52F), 5 Smoked Turkey Breasts (52F), 5 Boxes of Prepared Bacon (54F), 3 Boxes of Prepared Buffet Ham (52F), 3 Bags of Roast Beef (52.5F),  One Box of Smoked Bacon (52.5F), Three Boxes of Pepperoni (52.5F), 3 Containers of Roasted Garlic Base (52.5F), One Box of Roasted Poblano Base (52F), One Box of Chipotle Base (52.5F), Two Containers of Horseradish (51F), 4 Containers of Meijer Roasted Garlic Hummus (48.5F), One Container of Sabra Original Hummus (50.5F), Two Jars of Pesto (51F), Three Bags of Feta Crumbles (52F), One Box of Hard Boiled Eggs (51F), One Box of Goat Cheese (51F), One Box of Plain Greek Yogurt (51F), One Box + 4 Individual Containers of Whipped Cream (52F), Two Containers of Yogurt (52F), 4 Boxes of Yoplait (51.5F-52.5F), Two Boxes of Butter (51F), 3 Boxes of Single Serve Cream Cheese Spread (51F), One Box + One Container of Whipped Cream Cheese Spread (51.5, 53F), One Box of Cream Cheese (47.5F), 5 Boxes of Butter Chips (50-53F), 3 Cartons of Whole Eggs (52.5F), 3 Boxes of Heavy Cream (51-52F), 6 Boxes of Sliced Cheddar Cheese (50.5-52F),  One Box of Sliced Provolone Cheese (51.5F), Two Boxes of Sliced Jack Cheese with Peppers (51-51.5F), Two Boxes of Swiss Cheese (51.5F), One Package of Sliced American Cheese (51.5F), Two Containers of Ricotta Cheese (51F), Two Containers of Mozzarella (50.5-51.5F), 4 Cartons of Potato Salad (51F), 2 Boxes of Assorted Cheese Cubes (51.5, 52.5F), Two Boxes of Sour Cream (49.5, 51F), 3 Boxes of Shredded Mozzarella Cheese (49.5-52F), 4 Boxes of Shredded Cheddar Cheese (51-54F), Four Containers of French Dressing (52F), One Container of Chipotle Ranch (52F), One Container of Caesar Dressing (53F), Two Containers of BBQ Sauce (52.5F), Two Containers of Vinaigrette (52F), 3 Boxes of Chopped Cabbage Slaw Mix (48.5-51F), 6 Boxes of Cut Romaine Lettuce (50-52.5F), And One Bag of Salad Mix (53F). 

All Items were voluntarily discarded by PIC. Discussed with PIC; Ensure that the cooler temperature is checked regularly to prevent food spoilage. Cooler may need serviced to work properly.

Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control.
findings.comment:
The dish room cooler at the facility is not holding temperature. Inspector measured temperatures of food in the cooler to be between 48 and 52F. Food must be held at 41F or below. Discussed with PIC, and PIC called for service immediately. Inspector will return 09/19/2025 to re-inspect the temperature holding capabilities of the cooler. 

See violation 22 for food in the cooler.
findings.citation_text: 4-301.11 Cooling, Heating, and Holding Capacities. EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures as specified under Chapter 3.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a build-up of soils on the baffle of the ice machine. Discussed with PIC, and PIC immediately cleaned and sanitized the baffle. Ensure the baffle is cleaned regularly enough to keep soils from accumulating.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed the sliding door of the packaging room clear cooler is not completely shutting. The cooler is cold holding foods at proper temperatures (the ambient air is 35F). Ensure the door is repaired to properly shut. Physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. 

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
The back door in the dry storage area has a gap along the bottom and between the 2 doors, allowing sunlight through.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure gaps are sealed to prevent pest and rodent entry.

6-202.15: (A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. (B) Does not apply to FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS which opens into larger structure. (C) Exterior doors need not be self-closing if designed for limited-use. (D) If opening present, opening shall be protected against rodent and insects. (E) Paragraph (D) not applicable when pests are absent.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
The main 3 part sink needs to be cleaned and re-caulked, the current caulk is mostly missing.  The left side stainless steel of the new dish machine also needs to be caulked to the wall. Discussed with PIC.  Ensure the 3 part sinks are re-caulked to create a smooth and easily cleanable surface.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Double door cooler in the back used for bar items is still out of temperature on the top shelf (50F), but 42F on the bottom. Opened items are discarded and the top shelf is being taken out. There is also a pool of water on the bottom, and should be serviced or removed. Ensure the temperature of this cooler is being monitored and serviced.

3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
The soap dispenser at the hand washing sink was not operating correctly at time of inspection.  PIC fixed on-site.  Ensure the soap dispenser is always operating correctly and paper towels are in a convenient place.

6-301.11: Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
The ambient temperature of the walk-in cooler in the dish area was 46F at the coolest part right by the fan and 50F on the opposite side.  The probed temperature of sour cream was 47F.  Discussed with PIC, who is discarding all dairy based items and chopped vegetables.  A maintenance company is being called at time of inspection.  Ensure a temperature log of all the coolers is kept and recorded daily to monitor temperature.

3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
The temperature of the “cold bar cooler” in the back was 67F upon inspection.  Discussed with PIC who will be discarding juices that require refrigeration and open jars of fruit used for bar garnishes.  PICs discussed discontinuing use of this cooler and the inspector advised to remove the cooler if it will no longer be used.  Ensure temperatures of coolers are recorded daily to monitor temperatures.

3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
The door of the walk-in cooler in the dish area does not latch properly, causing the cooler to get warm and malfunction.  Discussed with PIC, who will soon have a person to do maintenance around the facility.  Ensure this door is fixed to allow the walk-in cooler to work and hold the proper cold holding temperature.

4-501.11: (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in good repair. (B) EQUIPMENT components shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted to manufacturer’s specifications. (C) Cutting or piercing parts of can opens shall be kept sharp to minimize metal fragmentation.

findings.title: Allergen training as required
findings.comment: 410 ILCS 625/3.07 Sec. 3.07. Allergen awareness training. (b) Unless otherwise provided, all certified food service sanitation managers employed by a restaurant must receive or obtain training in basic allergen awareness principles within 30 days after employment and every 3 years thereafter.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.comment:
Multiple cans were observed with dents on the top or bottom seams.  Discussed with PIC who pulled the cans for refund.  Ensure cans are checked upon delivery and any cans with dents on the seams are returned before being used.

3-202.15: FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Two 3 part sinks located in the back of the facility need to be cleaned re-caulked.  The current caulk is molded, cracked, and missing in some areas.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure the 3 part sinks are re-caulked.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
A bare wood board is still above the main 3 part sink used to clean the majority of the dishes.  The same board was present at the last inspection and was mentioned in the comments.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure board is sealed, painted, or removed.  If it is removed, seal the screw holes with caulk or a hole cover.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
A mop was observed stored in the mop bucket.  Discussed with PIC, store mops in the top part of the mop bucket or another position to allow the mop head to air dry to prevent mold and mildew growth.

6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
Bins holding clean utensils/lids were observed to contain food particles.  Discussed with PIC, regularly check bins for food debris or other contaminates.  Ensure bins are cleaned regularly to prevent food debris accumulation.

4-903.11: (A) clean FOOD-CONTACT surfaces shall be stored: in clean, dry location, not exposed to splash or other contamination, and at least 6 inches above floor.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Walk-in prep cooler fans were observed to have an accumulation of dust.  Discussed with PIC, keep fans free of dust to prevent contamination of cooling, non-covered foods in cooler.  Ensure fans are cleaned regularly to prevent dust accumulation.

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

Caulking is frayed at handsink, there is a gap between handsink and the wall. Replace caulking at this sink, and ensure all sinks are sealed to the wall properly.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. 

Facility is preparing food at this event (laying out kebabs on serving trays and slicing chicken breasts into sample-size portions. No temporary handwashing sink available. Service temporary halted until they are able to provide temporary handwashing at the location of food prep. Crowne Plaza provided a temporary handwashing station at vendor booth, and facility cleared to operate. Inspector will conduct a spot check at the brick and mortar in the coming weeks to discuss company policy with handwashing and applicable food code requirements.
